description: Flat record-level metadata schema for single amplified genomes (SAGs) of archaeal communities collected from extreme environments, including sample provenance, environmental conditions, lysis and amplification details, sequencing platform, and genome assembly provenance.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or SAG sample.

sample_id.descr: Original sample identifier assigned at collection or in the source study.

specimen_label.descr: Label or barcode used to track the individual SAG or cell-derived library.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling site, vent field, basin, spring, or other environmental location.

site_type.descr: General habitat category, e.g., hydrothermal vent, hot spring, acidic pool, hypersaline basin, anoxic sediment.

geographic_region.descr: Broader geographic region, island, ocean basin, or country/territory where the sample was collected.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

collection_depth_m.descr: Collection depth in meters below surface or seafloor; use negative values only if a local convention requires it, otherwise report depth as positive magnitude.

sample_matrix.descr: Material collected, e.g., water, sediment, biofilm, microbial mat, chimney material, subsurface fluid.

environmental_temperature_c.descr: In situ temperature at collection in degrees Celsius.

environmental_pH.descr: Measured pH of the sample environment at collection.

environmental_salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at collection in practical salinity units (PSU) or equivalent reported salinity measure.

environmental_pressure_bar.descr: Hydrostatic or ambient pressure at collection in bar.

environmental_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration at collection in mg/L; use 0 if anoxic and measured as zero, or leave blank if not measured.

environmental_redox_mv.descr: Redox potential (Eh) at collection in millivolts, if measured.

environmental_other_parameters.descr: Free-text summary of additional environmental measurements relevant to the site, such as sulfide, methane, iron, ammonia, or conductivity.

archaeal_target_group.descr: Target archaeal lineage or taxonomic group if known, e.g., Thermoproteota, Euryarchaeota, Asgard archaea.

single_cell_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the cell prior to lysis, e.g., FACS, micromanipulation, dilution-to-extinction, microfluidics.

lysis_method.descr: Primary cell lysis method used before amplification, e.g., enzymatic, thermal, alkaline, detergent-based, combined protocol.

lysis_reagents.descr: Key lysis reagents or enzymes used, such as lysozyme, proteinase K, SDS, alkali, or commercial lysis buffer.

lysis_incubation_conditions.descr: Lysis incubation details such as temperature, time, and any cycling conditions; report as a structured text string.

whole_genome_amplification_method.descr: Isothermal amplification method used, e.g., multiple displacement amplification (MDA), MALBAC, PicoPLEX.

amplification_kit.descr: Commercial kit name and manufacturer used for whole-genome amplification.

amplification_kit_version_lot.descr: Kit version, lot number, or product code if available for reproducibility.

amplification_conditions.descr: Amplification reaction conditions such as reaction volume, temperature, duration, and primer details; report as free text.

amplification_cycles.descr: Number of amplification cycles or equivalent amplification repetitions, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction method used, if DNA was extracted before library preparation or amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used, e.g., Illumina, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific sequencer model, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq, PacBio Sequel II.

sequencing_library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

read_type.descr: Sequencing read configuration, e.g., single-end, paired-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Reported read length in base pairs; for paired-end data, use the nominal read length per end.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Run identifier, flow cell ID, or lane ID associated with the sequencing output.

sequencing_center.descr: Name of the sequencing facility or core laboratory.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw reads generated before filtering or trimming.

quality_filtering_applied.descr: Whether read quality filtering or trimming was applied prior to assembly.

quality_filtering_tool.descr: Tool used for read trimming or filtering, e.g., Trimmomatic, fastp, Cutadapt.

assembly_software.descr: Genome assembly program used, e.g., SPAdes, metaSPAdes, MEGAHIT, Flye.

assembly_software_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters or command-line options used; provide as free text.

assembly_contig_count.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds in the assembled SAG genome.

assembly_total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs.

assembly_gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome expressed as a percentage.

assembly_coverage_x.descr: Approximate mean sequencing coverage across the assembled genome, expressed as fold coverage (X).

contamination_filtering_applied.descr: Whether contamination screening or filtering was performed on the assembly.

contamination_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated contamination percentage for the SAG assembly, if assessed.

completeness_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness percentage, if assessed.

completeness_tool.descr: Tool used to estimate completeness and contamination, e.g., CheckM, BUSCO.

annotation_pipeline.descr: Genome annotation pipeline or workflow used, e.g., Prokka, Bakta, NCBI PGAP.

annotation_pipeline_version.descr: Version of the annotation software or pipeline.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used to assign taxonomy to the SAG, e.g., GTDB-Tk, 16S comparison, phylogenomic placement.

assigned_taxon.descr: Final assigned archaeal taxon at the most informative available rank, e.g., genus or species if available.

functional_notes.descr: Brief summary of notable predicted functions or adaptations relevant to extreme-environment survival, such as sulfur metabolism, thermophily, or stress response.

ecosystem_process_relevance.descr: Free-text note describing the inferred contribution of the archaeal genome to ecosystem biochemical processes, such as carbon cycling, sulfur reduction, or methane metabolism.

data_repository_accession.descr: Primary accession or identifier in a public repository for the raw reads, assembly, or genome record.

associated_bioproject.descr: Project accession linking related samples and sequencing data, if available.

associated_biosample.descr: BioSample accession corresponding to the environmental specimen or cell-derived sample, if available.
